meta.title: Desktop Pet
meta.description: A real always-on-top desktop pet that acts out tool calls and shows token usage above its head, remembering position and character across sessions.

page.title: Desktop Pet
page.subtitle: A little creature living on your desktop, keeping up with the work.
page.bridgeMissing: No bridge information found. The pet plugin may not be active — restart DSH and come back.
page.petHint: The desktop pet is a standalone window. Closing it only hides the pet; the plugin keeps running.
page.followToolsHint: Thinking, reading, running commands, errors and completions each get their own pose and line.
page.clickThroughHint: Clicks pass to the window below. Turn it off from the tray menu.
page.idleChatterHint: When ignored for a while it mutters, dozes off and sleeps.
page.hungerHint: It will remind you when hungry; drop a file on it to feed it.
